# Telfer School of Management

> Telfer School of Management at the University of Ottawa is a triple-accredited business school committed to business for a better Canada through innovative programs, cutting-edge research, and community engagement.

Telfer offers undergraduate and graduate business education with a focus on sustainability, research excellence, and experiential learning. The school serves the Telfer Nation community through career development, student services, and alumni engagement initiatives.

## Key Topics

- [Our History - Telfer School of Management](https://telfer.uottawa.ca/en/about/our-history): Telfer's institutional history from founding to triple-accredited business school
- [Word from the Leadership Team - Telfer School of Management](https://telfer.uottawa.ca/en/about/word-from-the-leadership-team): Leadership vision for teaching, research, and policy at Telfer
